fusions.name: Firm Correction
fusions.desc: A rap with the rod that deals 7 damage and leaves the target 8% easier to wound for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Open-Palm Command
fusions.desc: Looses 5 bolts at once, spread apart, each of which deals 10 damage and stuns its target for 0.8 seconds.

fusions.name: Steadying Touch
fusions.desc: Removes up to 2 conditions from you and every ally.

fusions.name: Never Lets Go
fusions.desc: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
